title.narrative: Pillars 1: FAWS: Food Assistance, MPCA WaSH Support to 684 vulnerable households in North Lebanon (80% Leb - 20% Syr) engaging 20% PWD HHs 50% Female Headed-Households

ltpgtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtltbgtFAWS Project Summary:lt/bgtlt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtAnera proposes a multi-sectoral intervention that aims to address the urgent humanitarian needs and enhance the resilience of vulnerable communities in Tripoli a region severely affected by ongoing crises. lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtOur project titled: ltbgt"Food and MPCA Support to the most vulnerable households"lt/bgt lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gt(ltbgtFAlt/bgtlt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtltbgtWSlt/bgt) will serve ltbgt684 householdslt/bgt (lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gt80% Lebanese - 20% Syrian) with a targeted outreach plan to ensure the participation of ltbgtPLWD (gt20%)lt/bgt HHs and ltbgtfemale (gt50%)lt/bgt beneficiaries. lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtAnera's 'FAWS'lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gt lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gt(Meaning "ltigtWinlt/igt" in Arabic) project seeks to provide a comprehensive support package to ensure access to safe and nutritious food, lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtimprove livelihoodslt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gt in ltbgtTripoli: El Qobbe, Tibbene, Zeitoun, El Tell, El Haddadine, El Hadid Mina N3lt/bgt. lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtltbrgtFAWS will collaborate with different stakeholders to reach the most vulnerable households meeting one or more of the following profiles:ltbrgt4+ membersltbrgtchildren =5 yearsltbrgtPLWD or elderly (at least 20% HHs)ltbrgtfemale-headed HH (at least 50%)ltbrgtpregnant/lactating women.ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtltbrgtIdentification of HH will be through ltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtAnera’s own outreach, lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtreferrals fromlt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gt WFP, National Poverty Targeting Program (NPTP), and local organizations (including PLWD-specialized). Selection of beneficiaries will be based on the sector-approved vulnerability assessment of HHs, which will beltbgt customizedlt/bgt to assess particular vulnerabilities related to PLWDs and women.lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtltbrgtlt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtIn-Kind food parcels and Multipurpose Cash Assistance (MPCA) - ltspan style="font-size: 14px"gt5 rounds each, will be provided lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gton alternating months over a period of 11.5 months to all households. lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtlt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtThe food parcel will be modeled based on 60% of the standard FSAS guidance on Food Parcel composition, and the MPCA amount will be $50 - aligned with the national cash assistance schemes ($25/HH/Month). lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtProject log frame, delivery notes, stock control, and cash receipts will be the basis of monthly distribution monitoring and reporting. On 2 occasions (mid-term and project end) the project team will conduct a post-distribution evaluation with a sample of beneficiaries to measure the impact of the assistance.lt/pgtltpgtIn line with the localization strategy, ltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtAnera will partner withlt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gt lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtltbgta local organization lt/bgtandlt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gt mobilize the local community throughlt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gt lt/spangtltb style="font-size: 14px"gt10 trained youthlt/bgtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gt to help in HH identification, baseline assessment, monitoring and post-distribution assessment. lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtAnera will implement a thorough capacity building plan targeting partner organizations as well as other organizations operating in the targeted locations prioritizing 4 modules:lt/spangtlt/pgtltolgtltligtAAP Inclusionlt/ligtltligtFundraising and Grant Acquisition (including identification of and communication with donors, marketing tools, presentation skills etc...).lt/ligtltligtProject Design and Proposal Writinglt/ligtltligtUrban Agriculturelt/ligtltp class="" style=""gtltbrgtlt/pgtlt/olgtltp style="" class=""gtAnera's management and operations team in Beirut will lead the development of tools, competitive procurement, finance and compliance management, MEAL, and reporting.ltbrgtlt/pgtltp class="" style=""gtAnera will leverage its solid relationships with the local NGOs with which Anera has had successful previous experiences in food distribution and which have the infrastructure and systems to ensure project success (outreach, space, logistic support, etc.).lt/pgtltp class="" style=""gtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgt
In designing the FAWS project, Anera coordinated with several stakeholders including community members, municipalities, FSAS, WaSH, BAWG, Nusaned, Taawoun, LARI and the North water establishment.ltbrgtlt/pgt
